first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.

A compact-switch lemma is a candidate only after its mathematical contract is reviewed. Establish a bounded proof plan before a separately budgeted proof-assistant build; do not rerun large Lean jobs as orientation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can reduce the conditional gap even if it does not change kappa.

actual_scope: Prove the exact binary-independence criterion and direct construction for every normalized labelled characteristic-two Desargues incidence interface; derive its all-field count and check the new F32 parameter domain.
scope_change_reason: Open next question 4 of thakrarsagar PR2274 asks for the field-size explanation. This is a written side-interface proof with an exact polynomial certificate, rather than proof-kernel formalization or a selected-caller audit.
bottleneck_link: Side result for the complex decoder certificate interface. It replaces field-wide incidence discovery by an explicit parameter criterion, without a physical supplier or kappa claim.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved normalized parameter law with exact polynomial checks and independent finite incidence corroboration. Do not extend to other configurations or optimize physical costs.
evidence: All 100 symbolic point-line products checked; 14 affine forms; independent cross-product geometry on all 32768 F32 triples gives 20160 exact and 12608 rejected; 14 condition-deletion cases, degree-four witness and 3 rejecting controls.
